blocks.text: As I heard it, I now tell it: Baba Ji became inwardly detached and turned toward udasi. (32)
Going to the river with a companion, he entered the waters and did not emerge for a watch of the day. (33)
An alarm spread everywhere: people cried that he had drowned, and Daulat Khan came running. (34)
Search was made by every means, but he was not found. People said he had crossed beyond the visible shore. (35–36)
